question: K is the son of I. I is the father of L. L is the mother of O. O is the brother of S. How is K related to O?
solution:
Decoding symbols for Family Tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/153c6a6e313de03f2911e6352e768c319ce48bd8d9b10cf6c7d58c07f604979a.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b1b09affccba1eb7e68773889c21e4be0815c027c01e38f51c65006cdec8fb9.png] 

Given:

K is the son of I. 

I is the father of L. 

L is the mother of O. 

O is the brother of S.

K is the brother of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/961fe2c54b9acf01c7d9f84eafcd14ebb05bd2f5915a74b3c92ef49b1f54aef5.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d003ae52808691734cb4882144aa4e80e7b9786a59e87ecd6fb72e798508ae6.png] 

Thus, K is the Mother's brother of O.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
